headline.purpose: States the current room task once per view.

label.purpose: Controls, fields, statuses, codes, and validation.

shadows.name: widget-float
shadows.purpose: Separates the centered desktop widget from the page canvas.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Default transition for border, background, filter, transform, and shadow changes; collapse to 0.01ms for reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The full-width action that creates a room.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 44px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(115deg, #2f8dff, #7766ff); box-shadow: 0 7px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.25); color: #f7f8ff; font: 800 13px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, filter 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82c9ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A compact companion action for joining or sending.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 17px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #294bc2; color: #f7f8ff; font: 800 13px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms ease, filter 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82c9ff; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: The default recessed field for names and messages.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-name">Display name</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-name" placeholder="How others will see you">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin: 0 0 7px; color: #dbe4ff; font: 800 12px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid #1a275f; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; background: #080c28; color: #f7f8ff; font: 500 14px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color: #263a8c; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #82c9ff; background: #0a1032; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.22); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #7f8fc3; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Room Code Field
components.description: The code-first entry field with shareable character treatment.
components.css: .ds-code-input { width: 100%; height: 44px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid #1a275f; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; background: #080c28; color: #f7f8ff; font: 500 14px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease, background 150ms ease; } .ds-code-input:hover { border-color: #263a8c; } .ds-code-input:focus { border-color: #82c9ff; background: #0a1032; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.22); }

components.name: Connection Pill
components.description: A compact connection state with a semantic dot.
components.css: .ds-status-pill { display: inline-flex; min-height: 28px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #090e2e; color: #aebce8; font: 800 11px "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-status-dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #55e0ad; } .ds-status-pill:hover { background: #0d1236; } .ds-status-pill:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82c9ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Message Bubble
components.description: A participant message inside the recessed message well.
components.css: .ds-message { margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: #121b4e; color: #eaf0ff; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: 500 13px/1.45 "Nunito", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-message strong { display: block; margin-bottom: 2px; color: #54b8ff; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-message:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-message:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #82c9ff; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
OrbChat is one compact path into a temporary room. Its visual system makes the experience feel immediate and contained: deep navy surfaces create a private enclosure, electric blue provides structure and action, and the supplied full OrbChat wordmark establishes its place in the Orb Games family.

The system is a compact embedded utility, not a dashboard. Nunito, rounded controls, short labels, and dense but breathable spacing keep it friendly without weakening its code-first purpose. The same visual language must remain complete when the widget expands to a full mobile viewport.
keyCharacteristics: Deep navy surfaces with electric-blue structure and restrained purple energy.
Compact, centered composition built around one clear task path.
Heavy, rounded Nunito typography with small, legible status labels.
Rounded controls and containers with explicit focus and connection states.
Full OrbChat wordmark as the primary identity asset.

rules.name: The Electric Structure Rule
rules.body: Blue marks action, focus, and essential room information; it is not ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Navy Layer Rule
rules.body: Separate regions by moving between the established navy surfaces before adding borders or shadows.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Nunito throughout; hierarchy comes from weight, size, tracking, and case rather than a second typeface.

rules.name: The Code Clarity Rule
rules.body: Room codes use uppercase tabular characters with generous tracking so every character can be shared and checked quickly.

rules.name: The Tonal-First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy with navy surface changes; shadow supports a layer but never defines it alone.

dos: Do keep room entry and messaging inside a single compact path with the most important action visually dominant.
Do use the established navy layers before reaching for extra borders or shadows.
Do reserve electric blue for action, focus, and essential room information.
Do preserve clear hover, focus, active, connected, connecting, disconnected, validation, and disabled states.
Do let the widget become the full page at narrow mobile widths.
donts: Don't add dashboard chrome, navigation, onboarding panels, or decorative modules around the utility.
Don't replace the supplied full OrbChat wordmark with plain text, a cropped symbol, or a new logo treatment.
Don't introduce sharp rectangular controls, pale surfaces, or typefaces outside the Nunito system.
Don't use purple as an independent semantic action or status color; it supports the primary action gradient.
Don't use shadow as the only cue separating nested navy surfaces.
